scope: Training vertical loop: Coach publication, Client session results, Coach history

interfaces.write: POST /api/v1/client/workouts; authenticated identity is resolved server-side

invariants: A workout belongs to an immutable publication/week/session
One result per scheduled session and publication
Partial explicit online saves; version checks and idempotent retries
Completed result is immutable; no rewrite when Coach publishes a new plan
New sessions may start on the current publication only; started older sessions may finish
Client can only write own results; verified assigned Coach/Admin reads, not edits Client measurements
All prescribed sets must be DONE or SKIPPED before completion; skips require a note
Server derives prescribed/EXTRA status and unit; EXTRA sets limited to twenty per exercise
No target is silently copied into actual performance
History retains all previous publications; paginated twenty sessions
Session GET sends publication once and hydrates the exact prescription in the UI
No private browser persistence; network failures do not imply success
Coach history refreshes on visibility/focus and explicit refresh
notIncluded: New artistic direction or visual generalization
Calendar date assignment or automatic week advancement
Rest timers or full Legacy guided execution engine
Program or result migrations from Legacy
verification: SQL/RPC authorization, RLS, publication locks, validation, immutable closure, idempotent audit
Full browser Coach to OTP Client session results and back to Coach
Isolated staging real synthetic program/session walkthrough
